body.intent: Ship-change fixes red CI after land: when landed-green or rebased-merge-green finds main's checks failed with parsed test failures (after the once-per-head rerun), run a fixer cycle instead of failing the run. Change set 01M6MBPT (Ship-change fixes red PR CI) covers only pr-green and rebased-green, because re-entering render-pr after rhiza ship land would land twice; this post-land path needs its own route (a follow-up PR or commit on main, not a second land).
body.title: Ship-change fixes post-land CI
